links.comparator_used: Standard GPT4 without the guideline knowledge base (training knowledge alone)
links.outcome: Correct colonoscopy screening/surveillance advice across domains (high-risk feature identification, correct interval, guideline citation) on 62 case scenarios, each tested three times
links.effect: Contextualized model outperformed standard GPT4 in all domains; no high-risk features missed; a correct interval was given in the majority of cases; guidelines were cited appropriately in almost all cases. Numeric values are not given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Hallucination of additional high-risk features occurred in two cases; the interval was not correct in all cases.
links.quote: The contextualized GPT4 model outperformed the standard GPT4 in all domains.

design_hint: retrieval grounding with guideline knowledge base
